query:
SELECT c.id AS "id!: _", c.project_id AS "project_id!: _", c.unit_id AS "unit_id!: _", h.number AS "unit_number!", h.state AS "unit_state!", c.attempt_id AS "attempt_id?: _", a.sequence AS "attempt_sequence?", a.state AS "attempt_state?", c.kind AS "kind!", c.subject_revision AS "subject_revision!", c.state AS "state!", c.opened_at AS "opened_at!: _", c.resolved_at AS "resolved_at?: _", c.failure_id AS "failure_id?: _", c.evidence_id AS "evidence_id?: _", c.writeup_id AS "writeup_id?: _", c.origin AS "origin!", c.source_ref AS "source_ref?" FROM 
    review_cases c JOIN units h ON h.id = c.unit_id
    LEFT JOIN attempts a ON a.id = c.attempt_id

            WHERE c.project_id = $1
              AND ($2::text IS NULL OR c.kind = $2)
              AND ($3::text IS NULL OR c.state = $3)
              AND ($4::uuid IS NULL OR (c.opened_at, c.id) < (
                  SELECT opened_at, id FROM review_cases
                  WHERE id = $4 AND project_id = $1))
            ORDER BY c.opened_at DESC, c.id DESC
            LIMIT $5
